heading: Buy on the operating numbers. Create value with a hammer.
lede: Two strategies, one underwriting standard: stabilized value less remaining capital expenditure sets the price we are willing to pay.

items.title: Value-add multifamily
items.body: Under-managed 20-to-150-unit assets in Ohio markets with a rent-to-market gap we can evidence today, deferred maintenance we can price before closing, and an operating expense line a professional manager can move. Renovate unit-by-unit on natural turn, re-tenant, then refinance or sell into a stabilized cap rate.

items.title: Adaptive reuse and residential development
items.body: Buildings and land acquired subject to entitlement, taken through variance and site plan, then constructed by our own builder. Development margin plus a stabilized asset, rather than one or the other. Entitlement risk is carried before closing, not after.

pullQuote: The exit is underwritten before the offer goes out — not discovered in year three.
